draft_evidence.quote: “I knew his classification. I was standing beside him when it was issued.”

comparison_evidence.quote: “You knew he was Standard Eight.” “I knew his classification.”

findings.consequence: The added eyewitness claim fixes Sen's location and participation at Aaron's classification, creating a new historical continuity obligation not established by the frozen source or ledgers.
findings.repair_target: Remove the claim that Sen stood beside Aaron when his classification was issued, retaining only her established knowledge of the classification.

draft_evidence.quote: “I was twenty-five, and frightened, and quite sure the secrecy was temporary.”

comparison_evidence.quote: “Because thirty-one years ago I was young, frightened, and convinced secrecy was temporary.”

findings.consequence: The exact age creates a new birth-year and historical-timeline constraint where the frozen evidence establishes only that Sen was young.
findings.repair_target: Replace “twenty-five” with the established non-exact description “young” or equivalent phrasing that does not create new canon.
